title: Being honest with Dev
summary: Jordan came clean to Dev about canceling their Monday plans, admitting the real reason (a bad day at work followed by shutting down) rather than sticking with the "swamped" excuse—a message they rewrote several times before sending. Dev responded with warmth and their own admission of disappearing when overwhelmed, and the two made plans for lunch Saturday, leaving Jordan feeling unexpectedly lighter. The entry closes with Jordan reflecting on how protecting the appearance of being "fine" only prolongs their withdrawal, noting that unlike Mika, Dev doesn't yet have the history to see through it, so Jordan has to consciously choose honesty.
